question.problem:
$$
{f}_{X|Y}(x\,|\,-4)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{7}{2{x}^{9/2}}, & \,x\ge 1 \\ 0, & \,\text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

Let $X$ and $Y$ be continuous random variables. 
Find the conditional variance $\text{Var}[X\,|\,Y=-4]$ given that the conditional probability density function ${f}_{X|Y}(x\,|\,-4)$ is shown above and the corresponding expected value is ${\mu }_{X|-4}=\frac{7}{5}.$
question.worked_solution:
Recall that the conditional variance of $X$ given $Y=y$ is defined by

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Var}[X\,|\,Y=y] & =\text{E}[(X-{\mu }_{X|y})^{2}\,|\,Y=y] \\  & =\text{E}[{X}^{2}\,|\,Y=y]-{\mu }_{X|y}^{2},\end{aligned}
$$

where 

$$
\text{E}[{X}^{2}\,|\,Y=y]={\int }_{-\infty }^{\infty }{x}^{2}\,{f}_{X|Y}(x\,|\,y)\,\text{d}x.
$$

Therefore, we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[{X}^{2}\,|\,Y=-4] & ={\int }_{-\infty }^{\infty }{x}^{2}\,{f}_{X|Y}(x\,|\,-4)\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{\infty }{x}^{2}\cdot \frac{7}{2{x}^{9/2}}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{\infty }\frac{7}{2{x}^{5/2}}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{\infty }\frac{7}{2}{x}^{-5/2}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={[\frac{7}{2}\cdot (-\frac{2}{3})\cdot {x}^{-3/2}]}_{1}^{\infty } \\  & ={[-\frac{7}{3{x}^{3/2}}]}_{1}^{\infty } \\  & =0-(-\frac{7}{3}) \\  & =\frac{7}{3}.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally,

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Var}[X\,|\,Y=-4] & =\text{E}[{X}^{2}\,|\,Y=-4]-{\mu }_{X|-4}^{2} \\  & =\frac{7}{3}-{(\frac{7}{5})}^{2} \\  & =\frac{7}{3}-\frac{49}{25} \\  & =\frac{28}{75}.\end{aligned}
$$
